sources.publisher: Bulgarian Ministry of Environment and Water
sources.article_or_section: Adoption notice: four basin districts; prevention, protection and preparedness
sources.paraphrase: MOEW reports adoption of four basin Flood Risk Management Plans for 2022–2027. The notice concerns strategic planning; the selected local measure and responsible institution still require the actual plan.
sources.translation_status: Official English notice; plan text not reviewed
sources.scope_note: A planning programme is not a real-time activation instruction.

sources.publisher: Bulgarian Ministry of Environment and Water
sources.version_or_last_verified: Public page retrieved 2026-10-24; consolidation not applicable
sources.paraphrase: MOEW describes national water-management policy and basin-level institutions. Confirm the competent Basin Directorate and the applicable flood-risk plan before assigning a case-specific task.
sources.scope_note: No gauge-to-jurisdiction crosswalk is present in the local data.
